verses.t: I swear by this city, Makkah
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city

verses.t: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city
verses.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city

verses.t: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]
verses.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat

verses.t: We have certainly created man into hardship
verses.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere

verses.t: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him

verses.t: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance
verses.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth

verses.t: Does he think that no one has seen him
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him

verses.t: Have We not made for him two eyes
verses.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

verses.t: And a tongue and two lips
verses.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips

verses.t: And have shown him the two ways
verses.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways

verses.t: But he has not broken through the difficult pass
verses.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent

verses.t: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is

verses.t: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.pickthall: (It is) to free a slave

verses.t: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger

verses.t: An orphan of near relationship
verses.pickthall: An orphan near of kin

verses.t: Or a needy person in misery
verses.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery

verses.t: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
verses.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity

verses.t: Those are the companions of the right
verses.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand

verses.t: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left
verses.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand

verses.t: Over them will be fire closed in
verses.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them
